# 8A34001 (ZCU216 U409) -- Q7 and Q11 = 156.25 MHz LVDS, all other outputs high-Z
# Loaded by gt_refclk.program_gt_refclk(). Timing Commander burst format:
# 'Offset: FC' lines set the page register (00 <page> 10 20).
#
# DERIVED, NOT A TIMING COMMANDER EXPORT FOR THIS BOARD. Base file:
#   Xilinx system-controller-app BIT/clock_files/8A34001/8A34001_2020-0318_156MHz.txt
#   (VCK190/VPK120 default; https://github.com/Xilinx/system-controller-app)
#   sha256 7764c11ae90710c56747ecafad857958bbf039d35248a88733c17a6b6a9cf5be
#   Its .tcs summary: crystal 54 MHz (doubled, APLL 13716 MHz), XO_DPLL 38.4 MHz,
#   DPLL0/1/2/3/5/6 at 625 MHz, Q0-Q10 156.25 MHz, Q11 off. Firmware-4.8 register map.
# ASSUMPTION: the ZCU216's U409 has the same 54 MHz crystal as the VCK190. If it does
# not, the system APLL will not lock and program_gt_refclk() raises (APLL lock poll).
#
# Bytes changed from the base (address: old -> new):
#   0xCA13: 0x00 -> 0x01  OUT_DIV_MUX.OUT_DIV11_MUX: FOD6 drives Q11 divider (coupled)
#   0xCA1C: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_0.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q0 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA2C: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_1.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q1 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA3C: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_2.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q2 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA4C: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_3.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q3 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA5C: 0x03 -> 0x00  OUTPUT_4.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q4 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA6C: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_5.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q5 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCA88: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_6.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q6 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCAA8: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_8.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q8 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCAB8: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_9.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q9 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCAC8: 0x41 -> 0x40  OUTPUT_10.OUT_CTRL_0: PAD_MODE -> high-Z (Q10 not needed on ZCU216)
#   0xCAD0: 0x00 -> 0x04  OUTPUT_11.OUT_DIV = 4 (625 MHz / 4)
#   0xCAD8: 0x00 -> 0x41  OUTPUT_11.OUT_CTRL_0: differential, VOS 1.3 V, swing 410 mV (as Q7)
#   0xCAD9: 0x00 -> 0x20  OUTPUT_11.OUT_CTRL_1: squelch off, VDDO 1.8 V (as Q7)
# The table above is the complete diff; every other Size: line is the base file verbatim.
